_comment: Legal Center (/legal). Only documents that exist under public/ are listed; nothing here invents legal text. `updated` is the 最後更新 line inside each document and doubles as the version an acknowledgement records. Audiences: shop_buyer 商城買家 / household 住戶 / building 建案與社區 / partner 合作夥伴.

summary.zh: 使用 enGo 智慧管家 App、牆掛平板、社區服務與智管家商城的共同約定：帳號、服務範圍、社區守則、智慧財產與準據法。
summary.en: The shared agreement for the enGo app, wall tablet, community services and the enGo Store: accounts, scope of service, community conduct, intellectual property and governing law.

summary.zh: 我們蒐集哪些個人資料、為了什麼目的、與哪些第三方（金流、物流）分享、Cookie 的使用，以及您依個資法享有的權利。
summary.en: What personal data we collect and why, which third parties (payment, logistics) receive it, how cookies are used, and your rights under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act.

summary.zh: 透過 smtengo.com 或智管家商城直接向本公司購買的商品：七日鑑賞期、一年保固、生鮮與耗材的例外、退款流程與設備損壞條款。
summary.en: For goods bought directly from the company via smtengo.com or the enGo Store: the 7-day inspection period, one-year warranty, perishable and consumable exceptions, refund process and equipment damage clause.

who.zh: 在智管家商城購買商品、訂閱社區服務的消費者。
who.en: Consumers buying goods or community subscriptions in the enGo Store.

who.zh: 使用 enGo 牆掛平板與 enGo智慧管家 App 的家庭用戶。
who.en: Households using the enGo wall tablet and the enGo智慧管家 app.

who.zh: 導入 enGo 社區服務的建商、管委會與物業管理單位。
who.en: Developers, management committees and property managers running enGo community services.

who.zh: 裝修、廚具、設備與商城上架的合作廠商。個別合作協議由專人另行提供。
who.en: Renovation, kitchen, equipment and marketplace partners. Individual partner agreements are provided separately by our team.
